L1·N10370unmasked layer
Fires on space-prefixed word tokens (mostly capitalized proper-noun-ish words like " We", " Roll", " Ding", " Kai", " Life") and is strongly suppressed on the mirror case — capitalized words glued directly to preceding punctuation with no space (".Free", ",Double", "canCh", ",Phil") — so it's essentially tracking the leading-whitespace/word-boundary property of a capitalized token rather than any semantic content.
